title: Give the funnel pages their own layouts: /for, /vs, /subscribe, /free-spotlight, /mindless and the /create-a-space sections

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-04 on the marketing pages: "they are all really flat and text based. Make each a different layout that speaks to the feature, program or service." Lane B of the marketing evolution.

detail: Same words, headings, schema, links and form behavior; new layouts on the design system's textures. /for: the question beside a three-photo collage, the doors as persona tiles (photo with the door's words on glass, the first one large; a photo row on a phone). /vs: the copy beside two circles (an outline and a photo of a Circle), each comparison a split card with the registry's first row on a plain half and a glass half. /subscribe: a warm photo with the form on glass in the first screen, the steps down a dotted line beside the questions; /subscribe/confirm gets a photo stage with the box on glass. /free-spotlight: one portrait in an iridescent frame, the three cards stacked like pages, the steps as orbs on a dotted line with the last one lit. /mindless: a dusk photo hero with the timer lifted into it on glass over breath rings (FnHero image, FnColumn glass; funnel/parts.tsx adds no import). /create-a-space sections: a photo collage with a phone rail, a held heading beside the tools under a signal line, the free promise on glass over a photo band, a held FAQ heading, a night photo under the closing call. photo-bg.ts also routes /images/site stills through the optimizer.
